name: generative-interaction-kernel
description: Generative Interaction Kernel workspace: GIK wire schemas, conformance fixtures, and the reference implementation.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names functions,host "npm run func:local" "cross-env VITE_GIK_HOST_ENV=local npm run dev:host"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p kernel/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/evaluators/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p adapters/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/blueprint/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/blueprint-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/demo-runner-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p face/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p transports/http-sse/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p transports/mcp-http/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/apps/host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/backend-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/agent-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/control-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p providers/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/component-infinite-canvas/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/gik-meta/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run conformance && npm run typecheck && npm run test:jsonata && npm run test:vitest
scripts.sync:public-docs: node scripts/sync-public-docs.mjs packages/kernel packages/controlface packages/agentface packages/blueprint packages/blueprint-host packages/demo-runner-host packages/evaluators packages/react packages/transport-http-sse packages/transport-mcp-http packages/component-infinite-canvas packages/provider-consequence-graph packages/provider-exploratory-graph packages/provider-blueprint-authoring packages/provider-step-orchestrator packages/gik
scripts.release:gate: npm run sync:public-docs && npm run build:public-packages && npm run test
